paragraphs.text: 拒绝会把智能体循环钉住的工具参数：阻塞等待、临场延长超时，以及可选的同步长任务。
# dsh-ban-wait
One Host plugin that refuses tool arguments which would park the DSH agent loop.

It exists because the shell command timeout is not a ceiling. `pwsh-sandbox`'s
`timeoutMs: 1000` pro

motes a long command to a background job, but the model can
pass `timeoutMs: 180000` on the call its

elf and the executor honors it up to
`maxTimeoutMs` (600000 ms by default) — three minutes inside on

e tool call. The
same class of leak is `job_output { wait: true }`, clamped only by a 10-minute
defa

ult. This plugin makes "no single call parks the loop" a property of the
tool registry instead of a
property of the model's discipline.
## Files
| File | Role |

| `index.js` | the plugin: policy + global `ctx.tools.guard()` |
| `check.mjs` | offline self-check

of the policy (30 assertions, no DSH process) |
| `bundle-check.mjs` | pre-install check: replays wh

at the plugin page inspects, with the harness's own patch loader |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | the bundle

's patch: inserts the Host-plane row |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`; n

s the Host-plane row |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`; no dependencies |
## Policy
| Config field | Default | Meaning |

| `maxBlockingMs` | `1000` | ceiling for any per-call blocking hint the model supplies |
| `denyWait

Tools` | `["job_output"]` | tools whose `wait: true` is refused |
| `timeoutHintTools` | `["pwsh", "

bash"]` | tools whose `timeoutMs` / `timeout_ms` is checked against `maxBlockingMs` |
| `requireBack
groundTools` | `[]` | tools that must be called with `run_in_background: true` |

A refusal is a `Error: …` tool result that names the ban, clears the background
job of blame, and st

ates how to re-issue the call, so the model recovers in one
step. An unusable config value is logged

and replaced by its default rather than
thrown: a typo here must not fail the instance's boot.
## Install

Through the plugin page — the only channel that keeps the plugin visible in the
inventory with its o

e plugin page — the only channel that keeps the plugin visible in the
inventory with its own toggle:

1. **添加插件** → paste the absolute project directory
(the checkout you just cloned). A local directory

is recognised by
`isAbsolute()` before any npm-spec parsing and never touches a registry, so
the re

gistry chooser in that dialog is irrelevant.
2. The manager reads `package.json`, requires a `name`

and a `dsh.bundle`, adds
the dependency to the profile, then reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles`
automa

tically ("new bundle dependencies activate automatically"). The plugin
then appears under 已安装 with a

toggle.
3. If the result reports that a restart is required, restart the instance: a new
Host modul
e generation is not loaded into a running process.

Do **not** also add a raw loader row for this plugin to the profile patch. The
bundle's `cordis.patc

h.yml` inserts row id `ban-wait`, and two rows sharing that
id make id-targeted patches — the toggle
, any override — reach only one of them.

between the model and a

ation, without which the guard is the only thing standing

## Verify

Neither proves activation — that happens when the profile mounts the bundle's
layer, which the plugi
n page reports in its install result.
Live probes (each returns a refusal instead of executing):

Verified on instance 3080: both refusals fire, plain calls and non-blocking job
reads behave exactly

as before, and the row mounts and unmounts live — no
restart was needed for any of it.
## Boundaries

- The guard sees **arguments**, not duration. A tool with no blocking argument
that simply runs long

is out of its reach; that is what `requireBackgroundTools`
is for, and what the shell `maxTimeoutMs

` cap already handles for commands.
- `ask_user_question` is deliberately never banned: blocking on

a human is the
feature.
- `workflow` and a synchronous `subagent` are **not** banned by default. The

y do
real work inside the call, so backgrounding them changes how the result is
consumed. Enable per
tool when that trade is wanted:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Superseded

This plugin began as a single-rule ban that refused only `job_output { wait: true }`;
that early ver

sion has been folded into the policy shipped here, so there is nothing
left to install separately.
